test_ctc_criterion: test the CTC criterion by computing loss and gradients for sequence-to-sequence alignment
create_ctc_graph: create a CTC alignment graph from a target label sequence and blank token index
create_emissions_graph: create an emissions graph from emission probabilities with optional log-probability conversion
test_asg_criterion: test the ASG criterion by computing loss and gradients for alignment-free sequence modeling
test_asg_viterbi_path: test the ASG Viterbi path decoding to find the most likely label sequence
